wins.text: Q4 total revenue hit a record $18B, up 28% YoY, above guidance, driven by AI semiconductors and VMware
AI semiconductor revenue reached $6.5B in Q4, up 74% YoY, with custom accelerator business more than doubling YoY; full-year AI revenue grew 65% to $20B
Q4 adjusted EBITDA of $12.2B (68% of revenue) exceeded guidance of 67%, up 34% YoY; operating income a record $11.9B, up 35% YoY
Total AI order backlog exceeds $73B to be delivered over next 18 months, with Tomahawk 6 switch bookings at record rates and AI switch backlog alone exceeding $10B
Quarterly dividend raised 10% to $0.65/share for Q1 FY26, marking 15th consecutive annual dividend increase; $7.5B share repurchase program extended through end of calendar 2026

risks.text: Gross margins guided down ~100 bps sequentially in Q1 FY26 due to higher AI revenue mix; system/rack sales will further compress gross margins as more third-party components are passed through
Non-AI semiconductor revenue expected flat YoY at ~$4.1B in Q1 FY26, with enterprise spending showing limited recovery and no clear catalyst for near-term reacceleration
Infrastructure software revenue guided to only ~$6.8B in Q1 FY26, up just 2% YoY, with full-year growth expected at low double digits — a deceleration from Q4's 19% YoY growth

Supply chain constraints in advanced packaging (CoWoS) and TSMC 2nm/3nm wafer capacity remain ongoing challenges as AI backlog accelerates; Singapore facility being built to partially in-source packaging
Non-GAAP tax rate increasing from 14% to ~16.5% in FY26 due to global minimum tax and geographic income mix shift, creating an earnings headwind

guidance_items.detail: Q1 FY26 consolidated revenue guided to $19.1B, up 28% YoY
Q1 FY26 AI semiconductor revenue guided to $8.2B, up ~100% YoY; total semiconductor revenue ~$12.3B, up 50% YoY
Infrastructure software revenue ~$6.8B in Q1 FY26; full-year FY26 infra software growth expected at low double-digit %
Q1 FY26 consolidated gross margin guided down ~100 bps sequentially on higher AI mix; adjusted EBITDA ~67% of revenue
Non-GAAP tax rate rising from 14% to ~16.5% for Q1 and full-year FY26 due to global minimum tax

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Customer-owned tooling risk — whether XPU customers may increasingly internalize chip design capabilities and reduce reliance on Broadcom
Identity of the fifth XPU customer (OpenAI) and binding nature of the 10-gigawatt agreement vs. the separate XPU development program
Silicon photonics as a potentially disruptive interconnect technology and competitive threat from a rival's photonic fabric acquisition
